correctness.rationale: The shift graph is a union of simple cycles of length N/gcd(N,d); its triangle count T is N/3 exactly at the allowed shift d=N/3 and zero otherwise. Independently, orient the edges by +d and count 0→1 transitions X, so A_d=k-X even on monochromatic components. No two adjacent directed edges can both be starts. For j=1,2,3 the j-th falling moment of X is the number of ordered j-edge matchings times a_j=(k)_j(N-k)_j/(N)_{2j}, which is the probability of the specified j occupied and j empty sites. The matching counts are N, N(N-3), and N(N-4)(N-5)-6T: the last follows by inclusion-exclusion on the three adjacencies in a triple, with a triangle counted by the all-three intersection. Substitution into the centered moments gives the displayed mean, variance, baseline and +6Ta_3 correction (the third moment changes sign under A_d=k-X). The endpoint weights give a vanishing correction exactly as stated, and substitution at k=N/2 yields the opposite-sign formulas and the N=6 values. A fresh transfer-polynomial enumeration corroborates the formulas independent of the frozen edge-census code.
residual_risks: The replay is bounded and does not establish a full distribution equality or make any claim for the excluded antipodal matching. The falling-moment proof covers the stated infinite range.

evidence: Let a_j=(k)_j(N-k)_j/(N)_{2j}. With all degrees 2, N edges and common-neighbor sum 3T, Chen–Zhang's raw cut third moment reduces to 8[N a_1+3N(N-3)a_2+(N(N-4)(N-5)-6T)a_3]. The first two raw moments are 2N a_1 and 4[N a_1+N(N-3)a_2]. After centering, dividing the third by -8 gives the frozen baseline plus 6T a_3. The exact shift order is N/gcd(N,d), so in the permitted range T is N/3 at d=N/3 when 3 divides N, and zero otherwise.

originality.rationale: Chen and Zhang's 2014 arXiv v3 / 2015 publication contains the exact general fixed-graph permutation-null third moment of the cut count (Lemma 3.8). A fixed split is exactly uniform sampling of a k-subset. On the simple 2-regular shift graph the cut count equals 2k-2A_d, and specialization of their local counts gives the full formula including the triangle correction. The prior paper does not state the periodic interpretation; the arithmetic classification and balanced sign comparison follow directly on substituting the cycle length and half weight. This is verified implication, not a verdict based on missing literature.
residual_risks: The source comparison uses the readable public arXiv v3 HTML, not the inaccessible visual PDF equation layout. Chen–Zhang need not have stated or noticed the cyclic resonance as a named phenomenon for their exact formula to imply it. No claim is made about all related indexed source contents or historical priority beyond demonstrable coverage.
